# yellowdog_namespace (Resource)

Manages a namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A namespace groups compute, work and image resources, and is the unit that
# group roles can be scoped to. The platform will not delete a namespace once
# anything has been created in it.
resource "yellowdog_namespace" "example" {
  namespace = "example-namespace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the namespace's ID, a 6 character hexadecimal string, not its
# name.
terraform import yellowdog_namespace.example 1A2B3C
```
